privacy: Therapy Note Writer Privacy Policy: Last Updated: november 29, 2023 - Welcome to Therapy Note Writer! This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your personal information when you use our website, mobile applications, and services. By accessing or using Therapy Note Writer, you agree to the terms and practices described in this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree with our practices, please do not use our services. Information We Collect: 1. Personal Information: When you register for an account, we may collect information such as your name, email address, and other contact details. Payment information, including credit card details, may be collected for billing purposes. Information you provide when using our services, such as therapy notes, appointments, and other related content. 2. Usage Data: We automatically collect information about your usage of Therapy Note Writer, including but not limited to IP addresses, device information, browser type, and operating system. How We Use Your Information: We use the collected information for the following purposes: 1. Providing Services: To create and manage your Therapy Note Writer account. To facilitate communication between therapists and clients. To process payments and provide customer support. 2. Improving Services: To analyze usage patterns and improve the functionality and performance of Therapy Note Writer. To develop new features and services. 3. Communication: To send you important notifications, updates, and information related to your account. To respond to your inquiries and provide customer support. Data Sharing and Disclosure: We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties. However, we may share your information in the following circumstances: 1. Service Providers: We may engage third-party service providers to assist in providing our services. These providers are bound by confidentiality agreements and are only authorized to use your information to the extent necessary to provide the services. 2. Legal Compliance: We may disclose your information in response to a legal request or when required by law. However, no data transmission over the internet or electronic storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee the absolute security of your information. Your Choices: You can review, update, or delete your account information at any time. You may also opt-out of receiving certain communications from us. However, please note that opting out may limit your access to certain features of Therapy Note Writer. Changes to this Privacy Policy: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. We will notify you of any changes by posting the updated policy on our website or through other communication channels. Your continued use of Therapy Note Writer after the effective date of the updated policy constitutes your acceptance of the changes. Contact Us: If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact us at [contact@therapynotewriter.com]. Thank you for choosing Therapy Note Writer. Your privacy is important to us.
